# Tooltip

## Tooltip

A popover that describes its anchor: the element the wrapper holds is
described by the label through `aria-describedby`, and the popover opens
above it on hover, focus or touch.

### Decisions

`requires_parent`: ToggletipContent must be composed inside Toggletip; the reference draws the content only inside an open parent.

`no_reference`: the reference draws this member only inside an open parent, so it is measured through that parent's samples.

- The wrapper, not the anchor, owns the listeners: pointer, focus and touch
  events propagate to it, so the anchor keeps its own role and focusability
  and nothing is cloned.
- The popover is a bubble plus a caret clipped from a square rotated 45
  degrees; the seat mounts under every template and a theme whose caret
  cells are zero draws nothing, keeping the tree identical.
- `open` is controllable through `onOpenChange`; `enterDelayMs` and
  `leaveDelayMs` override the decision delays (100 ms both ways).
- A touch opens the popover immediately where no pointer exists - the
  roster's touch fallback - and Escape closes it.
- Where an `OverlayHost` is mounted the popover renders through it; else it
  renders in place, `fixed` on the web and `absolute` natively, positioned
  by `useAnchoredPosition` from the anchor's measured rect and flipped at
  the viewport edge.
- The compact kind draws the `tooltip_compact` member cells: the tooltip an
  icon button shows.

### Cells

- `color.tooltip_container` - bubble and caret fill
- `color.tooltip_label` - label color
- `type.tooltip_label`, `type.tooltip_compact_label` - label type styles
- `control.tooltip_padding_block`, `control.tooltip_padding_inline` - bubble padding
- `control.tooltip_radius` - bubble radius
- `control.tooltip_caret_width`, `control.tooltip_caret_height` - caret clipping box
- `control.tooltip_offset` - anchor-to-bubble spacing
- `control.tooltip_max_width` - bubble width ceiling
- `control.tooltip_compact_*` - the compact kind's padding, caret and offset
- `stacking.floating` - the popover's z-level

### Accessibility

- `role="tooltip"` on the popover; `aria-describedby` on the anchor names
  it; the caret is `aria-hidden`.
- Escape closes while open.

### Retired second reference

`none` - the compact geometry comes from the theme's `tooltip_compact`
cells.

## DefinitionTooltip

DefinitionTooltip underlines a term and shows its definition in a small inverse bubble when the term is pressed, or hovered when asked.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `touch_degraded` - fallback: opens on press without hover |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `string` | yes | The term; it carries the dotted underline that toggles the definition bubble. |
| `definition` | `string` | yes | The definition shown in the inverse bubble while the term is open. |
| `align` | `string` | no | The side and alignment the bubble opens on; the 12 Popover placements. Default `bottom`. |
| `autoAlign` | `boolean` | no | Flips the placement at the viewport edge. |
| `openOnHover` | `boolean` | no | Opens on the pointer entering the term and closes when it leaves. Default false: a press toggles. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | no | Initially open. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the term's pressable. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `maxWidth` | `control.definition_tooltip_max_width` |
| `paddingBlock` | `control.definition_tooltip_padding_block` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.definition_tooltip_padding_inline` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Term","definition":"The definition of the term"}` |
| open | `{"children":"Term","definition":"The definition of the term","defaultOpen":true}` |
| hover-mode | `{"children":"Term","definition":"The definition of the term","openOnHover":true}` |
| top | `{"children":"Term","definition":"The definition of the term","align":"top","defaultOpen":true}` |

## Toggletip

Toggletip pairs a label with an information button that toggles an inverse bubble of text and up to two actions.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `touch_degraded` - fallback: opens on press without hover |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | no | The ToggletipLabel text beside the button. |
| `buttonLabel` | `string` | no | The button's accessible name. Default `Show information`. |
| `content` | `node` | yes | The bubble's text. |
| `actions` | `array` | no | Up to two `{ label, kind: "link" | "button", href?, onPress? }` laid out at the bubble's base. |
| `align` | `string` | no | The side and alignment the bubble opens on; the 12 Popover placements. Default `bottom`. |
| `autoAlign` | `boolean` | no | Flips the placement at the viewport edge. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | no | Initially open. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the toggletip root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `offset` | `control.toggletip_offset` |
| `maxWidth` | `control.toggletip_max_width` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"label":"Toggletip label","content":"Helpful information for this field"}` |
| open | `{"label":"Toggletip label","content":"Helpful information for this field","defaultOpen":true}` |
| with-actions | `{"label":"Toggletip label","content":"Helpful information for this field","defaultOpen":true,"actions":[{"kind":"link","label":"Learn more","href":"#"},{"kind":"button","label":"Apply"}]}` |
| bottom | `{"label":"Toggletip label","content":"Helpful information for this field","align":"bottom","defaultOpen":true}` |

| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the actions row. |

## Tooltip

Tooltip is a short label on a bubble beside the element it describes, opening after a delay on hover or focus (on press where there is no hover), placed against its anchor and flipped to stay in view.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `touch_degraded` - fallback: opens on press without hover |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `overlay`, `anchored-position` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | yes | The anchor: the tooltip opens when it is hovered, focused or pressed and describes it. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | The tooltip's text; it describes the anchor through `aria-describedby`. |
| `fill` | `boolean` | no | The anchor fills its parent instead of hugging its trigger, for a trigger laid out against a fixed box. Default false. |
| `align` | `string` | no | The side and alignment the tooltip opens on: `top`, `top-start`, `top-end`, `bottom`, `bottom-start`, `bottom-end`, `left`, `left-start`, `left-end`, `right`, `right-start`, `right-end`. Default `top`; flips at the viewport edge. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | no | Draws the compact kind - the tooltip an icon button shows - from the `tooltip_compact` member cells. |
| `open` | `boolean` | no | Controlled open state. Absent: the tooltip keeps its own state, starting from `defaultOpen`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | no | Initially open while uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `function` | no | Called with the next open state on every open or close. |
| `enterDelayMs` | `number` | no | Milliseconds before a hover or focus opens the tooltip. |
| `leaveDelayMs` | `number` | no | Milliseconds before the pointer leaving or blur closes the tooltip. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the anchor wrapper. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `paddingBlock` | `control.tooltip_padding_block` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.tooltip_padding_inline` |
| `radius` | `control.tooltip_radius` |
| `caretWidth` | `control.tooltip_caret_width` |
| `caretHeight` | `control.tooltip_caret_height` |
| `offset` | `control.tooltip_offset` |
| `maxWidth` | `control.tooltip_max_width` |
| `paddingBlockCompact` | `control.tooltip_compact_padding_block` |
| `caretWidthCompact` | `control.tooltip_compact_caret_width` |
| `caretHeightCompact` | `control.tooltip_compact_caret_height` |
| `offsetCompact` | `control.tooltip_compact_offset` |
| `level` | `stacking.floating` |
| `delayOpen` | constant `100` (decision) |
| `delayClose` | constant `300` (decision) |
| `delayCloseCompact` | constant `100` (decision) |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Anchor","label":"Tooltip text"}` |
| open | `{"children":"Anchor","label":"Tooltip text","defaultOpen":true}` |
| compact | `{"children":"Anchor","label":"Saved","compact":true,"defaultOpen":true}` |
| bottom | `{"children":"Anchor","label":"Tooltip text","align":"bottom","defaultOpen":true}` |
